items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Do you know?' regarding Johnny Lindsay's brother, and the interviewee does not provide any personal information or confirmation of a relationship in the provided text.

ctx.x: Can you tell me, um, if, uh, Johnny Lindsay, I know his dad died 1951, I believe, up here, when I was here, I knew him, but his brother, somebody told me he had a brother still living here. Do you know?
